chunks: He said: "You will live therein, and therein you will die, and from it you will be brought forth."
ai.seo_question: What are the three stages of human existence mentioned in relation to the earth in this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-A'raf is often cited to affirm the physical reality of the resurrection, where the body returns to the earth from which it was created. It underscores the divine power to reassemble the scattered elements of the human form, linking the earthly cycle of life and death directly to the eschatological hope of emergence.
